candidates.summary: A lazy continuation line starting with `<` ends a details block opened in a blockquote or list item while that container stays open, so its close tag no longer pairs and the rest of the container falls inside the fold
candidates.failure_scenario: `> ` / `> body` / `lazy line` / `> ` / `> after`: goldmark offers the unprefixed `<` line to Open with the document as parent before it settles on a lazy paragraph continuation, so releaseDetails drops the blockquote's entry and gives its level back while the blockquote stays open. `> ` then finds an empty stack and renders as ``, and `after` moves inside the fold, hidden while it is collapsed. The same happens in a list item when a wrapped line opens on an autolink (` for details.`). Repeating the shape (`> ` / `> p` / `x`, 10 times) renders 10 nested details where the control with a plain lazy line stops at MaxGnoNestDepth, 4, against the ADR's Pairing and Depth cap bullets and TestDetailsNestBounded's claim.
